Are you passionate about enabling global mobility and creating practical compliant solutions? Can you work both strategically and hands-on in close collaborating with internal stakeholders as well as external immigration, tax and mobility providers?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new responsible for Global Mobility

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Global Mobility professional to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in establishing and managing the global mobility framework, ensuring compliance across all countries where we operate. This role combines policy development, process ownership and operational execution

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining  the Global HR team and report directly to Anne Marie Knuth, Head of HR Rewards, Data & Systems who is based in Hellerup. You will also be based in Hellerup.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Define and drive Ascendis' global mobility strategy aligned with business objectives and workforce needs.

• Establish principles, governance, and decision frameworks for international mobility.

• Ensure mobility programs balance employee experience, business flexibility and compliance requirements.

• Act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor to HR, managers and leadership on global mobility matters and being the primary point of contact for immigration requirements and travel-related compliance obligations.

• Identify and proactively manage risks related to immigration, employment law, cross-border taxation and social security

• Build scalable and efficient workflows for; work permit applications, visa administration, business traveler compliance, A1 certificates and social security coverage as well as cross-border employee movements, as well as managing and coordinating the applications globally.

• To ensure timely renewals and ongoing compliance of permits and authorizations.

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree and have 5-10 years of experience within global mobility, immigration, international HR and employment tax.

Furthermore, you have:

• In depth knowledge of immigration, work authorization, and business travel compliance.

• Experience managing cross-border taxation and social security matters.

• The ability to operate both strategically and hands-on in a growing global organization.

• Great stakeholder management skills and can see yourself partnering with HR, Legal, Payroll, and Finance to address complex international employment scenarios.

• Experience with vendor management as you will be the primary contact point to our external mobility vendors

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to monitor changes in global legislation and assess business impact while ensuring ongoing compliance.  We expect you to take ownership in continuously improving global mobility processes and procedures.

Travel: 10 days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Anne Marie Knuth, akn@ascendispharma.com

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged

**A Snapshot of Your Day

**The Commercial Sales Manager is responsible for optimizing the financial and commercial outcome of projects and takes the active role of negotiating the commercial parts of Offshore Service contracts. Do you want to be part of an industry that is striving to protect our planet from further damage? Are you one who looks for solutions and regards a problem as an opportunity? Are you a person who believes in getting things done right the first time? If yes, we are looking for an enthusiastic Commercial Sales Manager to join our dedicated Offshore Service Sales team. The role provides an opportunity to operate in a dynamic department working on some of the biggest, most complex renewable energy projects in the world; negotiating with customers the financial and commercial outcome of projects, putting together compelling offers, presenting to management and internal stakeholders and ultimately working collaboratively with our customers to grow the wind industry.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**

• You will be integral to the sales process for our wind turbine and service contract offerings for the offshore wind sector.

• You will be working, as part of team, to deliver deals shaped to represent the commercial interests of both our customers and the business.

• Working on multiple high value service and maintenance contracts at any one time,

• Working with the Sales Director and Sales Project Manager to develop and drive the sales strategy; subsequently taking the lead on all commercial elements of the process (such as currency risks, financial security, payment terms, insurance, export control, and compliance),

• Ownership of commercial and financial documents during the sales and bidding process

• Developing the negotiation strategy on commercial terms and conditions,

• Clarification, annotation, mark-up of Terms & Conditions with commercial and financial implications

• Leading the negotiation of commercial terms and conditions in coordination with the relevant departments (Legal, Insurance, Trade Finance, Finance, Tax, Export Control & Customs, Operations, Logistics, etc...),

• Leading commercial evaluation of risks and opportunities facing your projects,

• Understanding and demonstrating impact of changes on customer business cases for energy projects,

• Preparation and presentation of project specific sales forecasts and budgets to high-level management,

• Working with the commercial team to establish and implement efficient processes and best practices.

What You **Bring

**

• A passion for renewable energy and a sense of the importance to lead the change,

• Knowledge of customer business case, preferably for energy projects,

• Demonstrable commercial contract management skills including in commercial negotiations, preferably within sales and/or the energy or construction sector,

• Good interpersonal skills with ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment and the ability to multi-task to meet deadlines,

• An ability to communicate technically complicated topics concisely to high-level management and customers in a high-pressure environment,

• A good knowledge of cost calculation approaches, finance methods, and commercial financial topics (bonds, escalation, currency, indemnities, liabilities, etc.),

• Project management skills,

• Fluency in English, both orally and in writing, International experience and willingness to travel (25%) and work in a global environment,

• Qualified applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment (no work authorization sponsoring now or in the future),

• A degree, preferably in business admin, finance or law.

**Rewards/Benefits

**About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

**Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond and Recover.

Today, we employ more than 400 employees – and as the demand for cybersecurity grows, we need to grow too. We are looking for Identity Engineers - Sailpoint to join our Identity & Access Management (IAM) team operating in Denmark and Sweden.

So, if you want to become an expert in a growing security discipline within one of the leading technologies, alongside a dynamic, ambitious, and welcoming team of specialists, then you might be what we are looking for.

**Identity Security team

**Our team of experts includes professionals with diverse skill sets: engineers, consultants, architects, process specialists, and strategists. Together, we support our customers to prepare, initiate, develop and mature their IAM programs.

As a dedicated SailPoint partner in the Nordics, we take pride in contributing to the security and management of over 40,000 identities.

Our culture is built on collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning. You will be surrounded by experts who support and challenge each other to grow, whether through knowledge-sharing, hands-on problem-solving, or staying ahead of the latest identity threats. We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger, which is why we value team members from different backgrounds, industries, and walks of life.

**The Role you can own if you join the team

**As a Identity Engineer - Sailpoint, you will join a dedicated and supportive team of identity experts, working together to help our customers implement and maintain cutting-edge SailPoint technologies. You’ll collaborate closely with architects and stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into robust identity solutions. Whether you’re configuring connectors, designing rules and workflows, or developing custom provisioning logic, you’ll play a key role in delivering secure and efficient identity management for our clients.

**Typical tasks could be:

**

• Work with architects and stakeholders to understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

• Configure and maintain SailPoint connectors, design rules, and Life Cycle Management (LCM) workflows.

• Develop and maintain provisioning solutions tailored to customer application landscapes.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues within SailPoint IdentityIQ environments.

• Document processes, configurations, and solutions to ensure knowledge sharing and compliance.

• Support the integration of SailPoint with various platforms and applications.

• Participate in test and release management for identity solutions.

**Your Potential Background

**You might come from a variety of backgrounds, such as system administration or consulting, with hands-on experience in implementing SailPoint technologies. Whether you have worked on new projects or maintained existing installations, your technical curiosity and structured approach set you apart. If you enjoy working collaboratively, taking responsibility, and seeing projects through from start to finish, we would love to hear from you.

**What would we like to see from you?

**

• Hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud.

• Proficiency in Java and Beanshell scripting.

• Experience with PowerShell and Log4j2.

• Familiarity with on-prem environments and the underlying infrastructure required to operate SailPoint solutions.

• Ability to communicate clearly in English, both orally and in writing.

• A strong desire to learn and grow within the identity space.

**You get bonus points if you tick one or more of these boxes:

**While the following skills and experiences are a plus, they are not required—if you are motivated to learn and grow, we encourage you to apply!

• Previous experience with Active Directory & Entra ID.

• Knowledge of Azure IaaS & PaaS, Microsoft Graph, and Apache Tomcat.

• Familiarity with databases and SQL. Experience with SAML, OAuth, LDAP, and authentication protocols.

• Knowledge of Windows/Linux Server environments.

• Understanding of REST/SOAP web services, JSON, and SCIM 2.0.

• SailPoint certifications are highly appreciated.

**Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully - and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people - sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Jun/Mid Level Engineer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us - through the grind and the wins.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Owned an OCPP hardening project - chased down a recurring class of vendor quirks (malformed messages, connection drops, the long tail of hardware oddities), shipped the fix, and measurably cut failed sessions or disconnections for that device family.

• Helped shift the team from reacting to incidents to preventing them, through alerting and observability work that catches problems earlier.

• Made real progress on OCPP 1.6, OCPP 2.0.1, and OCPI standards work that other services and front-ends across Monta now rely on.

What You Will Do

• Build and maintain backend services in NetOps' OCPP and charge point domain - protocol handling, message processing, device state, integrations with hardware vendors.

• Debug things that only break in the field. A charge point in Belgium disconnects every 40 minutes - you'll read the OCPP traffic, reproduce it against our emulator, find the cause, and fix it.

• Improve observability and alerting. Add the metrics, dashboards, and alerts that mean the next person doesn't have to guess.

• Take part in on-call once you're ramped up, with a team that treats a rough night as a reason to fix the system, not a rite of passage.

• Automate manual work away - a meaningful part of NetOps' job is removing the human steps that don't scale as our network grows.

• Collaborate across Product, Support, and the operations teams who live with the consequences of what we ship. You won't work in a silo.

**A Brief Overview Of Our Tech Stack

**

• Kotlin services (JVM), with Java where it already lives

• PHP/Laravel monolith - parts of our charge point domain still run here

• OCPP 1.6 / 2.0.1 and OCPI protocol handling

• Event-driven work with Kafka where message volume calls for it

• Observability via Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch/Kibana

• AWS + Kubernetes, with Terraform for infrastructure

What We’re Looking For

• 1–4 years of backend engineering experience, or a strong junior track record with real production exposure. You write clean, readable code and finish what you start.

• Comfortable in a JVM language - Kotlin preferred, Java fine, and we'll help you get there from another stack if the fundamentals are strong. Willingness to touch PHP in our legacy monolith when the work calls for it.

• You enjoy debugging, genuinely - logs, traces, packet-level detail, weird one-off reports from a single customer.

• A sense of ownership - you follow your work into production, watch it, and flag problems early rather than waiting to be asked.

• Nice to have: curiosity about the physical world (our systems talk to metal boxes with electricity in them); clear communication - you can explain what broke and why to someone who isn't an engineer; advanced, deliberate use of AI tools in your daily engineering workflow.

• Bonus points for: exposure to OCPP, OCPI, EV charging, or the EV industry as a driver or enthusiast; IoT, embedded, or telemetry systems where devices in the field misbehave; event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-volume message processing; reliability/monitoring/on-call experience (Prometheus, Grafana, SLOs); Kubernetes, Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code exposure.

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway - we care about potential, not perfection.

**AI Competency

• You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• Analytics & ML: Langfuse, PyTorch, Mastra

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

**Position, purpose & impact

**As a Support Engineer in Global Tech Support, you will provide hands-on, customer-facing technical support that helps our customers operate Queue-it reliably during business-critical moments. Reporting to the Head of Global Tech Support, you'll join a global, collaborative support organization working across regions and cultures.

This role bridges customer needs with technically sound solutions - validating feasibility, answering technical questions, and guiding customers through supported implementation patterns. You'll troubleshoot incidents and product or integration issues with a calm, structured, and analytical approach, and contribute to proactive Event Support activities delivered together with Pre-sales & Solutions as part of Queue-it's professional services offering. This is a hands‑on role for someone who takes ownership and cares deeply about clear communication and reliable customer outcomes.

**Your toolkit

****Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Experience

**

• 1–3 years of experience in technical support, solutions engineering, web engineering, or a similar customer‑facing technical role.

**Skills

**

• Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred

**

• Programming or scripting experience, such as JavaScript, .NET, Java, PHP, or Lua, mainly for troubleshooting and understanding customer integrations.

• Experience with ecommerce platforms, ticketing platforms, or high‑traffic web environments.

**The role in action

**

• Provide technical support for Queue-it customers as part of a 24/7 follow‑the‑sun support setup, including incident handling, alert response, and ticket resolution.

**Why join the Queue

**In this role, you will be working from our Vesterbro office in Copenhagen - Queue-it's largest office and global headquarters. You'll also find a ping pong table, foosball, and regular social activities that bring colleagues together.

At Queue-it, you're trusted to work in a way that suits you best, supported by a strength-based approach and a flat hierarchy inspired by Danish work culture. You'll be part of a global, collaborative environment with colleagues from 40+ nationalities, where diverse perspectives are valued and teamwork across cultures is the norm. But we're more than just software. We're a global team representing 40+ nationalities across Denmark, the U.S., South Korea, Australia, and Japan. We believe in the power of trust – not only in the digital experiences we protect, but in the culture we build together.

We take a strength-based approach to work, encouraging people to do what they do best and supporting them to thrive. You'll join a supportive, collaborative environment that values individuality, learning, and connection. And yes – we like to have fun too. From regular social events and celebrations to cultural and learning initiatives, we make time to connect and enjoy the Queue.

We are empowered by trust and strengthened by people.

jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**

Are you a people leader with a strong programme and project management background? Do you excel at creating momentum, leading experienced project managers, and delivering complex transformation initiatives in a high-stakes environment?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will join the leadership team of the Athene Programme and take ownership of a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives across Supply Chain Management and Data Platform. You will lead a team of experienced project managers and play a key role in ensuring that projects are delivered successfully, while building a strong delivery culture and developing the people behind the delivery.

You will be expected to challenge stakeholders, create clarity in complexity, make decisions, remove obstacles, and help the organisation move forward. Success requires both strong leadership and strong execution capabilities.

What success will look like?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will be responsible for delivering business-critical transformation initiatives through others. Success is measured not only by project outcomes, but by your ability to build a high-performing team, create alignment across stakeholders, and drive execution in a complex international environment.

**During your first 6 months, we expect you to:

**

• Establish ownership of your project portfolio across the Supply Chain Management and Data Platform value streams.

• Build strong relationships with project managers, business leaders, IT stakeholders, and programme leadership.

• Create clarity around priorities, governance, delivery plans, risks, and dependencies.

• Put effective leadership and follow-up routines in place for the project managers reporting to you.

• Become a trusted sparring partner to the Programme Director and wider leadership team.

**Within your first year, you will have:

**

• Delivered key programme commitments according to agreed timelines and objectives.

• Built a motivated and high-performing team of project managers with clear accountability and ownership.

• Strengthened collaboration across Business Transformation, IT, and the business organisation.

• Established a strong delivery culture focused on transparency, execution, and shared accountability.

• Successfully supported major programme implementations and business readiness activities.

**In the longer term, you will:

**

• Build a project management capability that continues to create value beyond the Athene programme.

• Create an environment where talented project managers grow, develop, and choose to stay.

• Help strengthen STARK Group's overall transformation and delivery capabilities.

• Be recognised as a leader who turns complexity into tangible business results while bringing people along on the journey.

Team, Reporting Line & Collaboration

You will report to Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, and become part of the Athene Programme Leadership Team.

You will have direct people management responsibility for a team of experienced project managers, both internal and external, working across the Data Platform and Supply Chain Management value streams. Together, they are responsible for delivering some of the most important components of the Athene programme.

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Business Transformation, PMO, IT Delivery, value stream leads, business owners, and senior stakeholders across the Nordic organisation.

The role can be based either in Viby J (Aarhus) or Frederiksberg (Copenhagen). Regardless of your primary workplace, you should expect to travel to the other location approximately 1-2 times per month, typically for 2-3 days at a time, as your team and key stakeholders are based across both offices.

Who are we looking for?

You have likely built your career within project and programme management and are now motivated by leading people and creating results through others.

You know how to create structure without creating bureaucracy. You are comfortable making decisions, handling competing priorities, and maintaining momentum when things become complex. At the same time, you are a leader who builds trust. You challenge constructively, communicate clearly, and create accountability without creating fear. You are calm under pressure, pragmatic in your approach, and able to bring people together around a common goal.

It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

• Leading large-scale transformation programmes, ERP implementations, or business-critical change initiatives.

• Managing a portfolio of projects in an international matrix organisation.

• People leadership and development of project managers or similar delivery roles.

• Working across both business and IT environments.

• Programme governance, risk management, planning, and financial follow-up.

• Motivated by engaging with stakeholders in a value-driven and decentralised organisation

• Agile, waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches.

• Relevant certifications such as PRINCE2, PMP, MSP, PgMP, SAFe, or similar.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who combines strong leadership with strong execution. Someone who can create clarity when complexity increases, make decisions when needed, and build a team that succeeds together.

Welcome to the Athene Programme

Athene is one of STARK Group's largest transformation programmes and plays a central role in building the future technology and business platform for the entire group.

You will join a leadership team characterised by trust, openness, and a strong sense of shared responsibility. Decisions are often made through collaboration, relationships, and influence rather than hierarchy, making this an exciting opportunity for leaders who thrive in decentralised environments.

The pace is high, ambitions are significant, and change is constant. At the same time, you will join a team that genuinely supports one another and believes that long-term success is created together.

Want to know more and apply?

We are happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your opportunities at STARK Group. For questions regarding the role, please contact Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, at tommas.tygesen@stark.dk

We are looking for someone to join as soon as possible and will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis until the right candidate has been found.

STARK Group

• Supporting strong win rates for Custom Document Agent opportunities.
